notes.title: Game Takes Less Time to Beat
notes.content:
Less points are needed to unlock new levels.

Boat now has a trail behind it.

notes.title: The Boat Cannot Get Stuck Anymore
notes.content:
Updated some of the credits.

Crystals will disappear after 3 seconds if the boat gets stuck. 

Small code optimizations.
